**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 11 (Transition Assistance and Data Return) already meets or exceeds our preferred position:

- **11.1** — up to six months of transition assistance on our request, on any expiry or termination, priced at the expiring Order Form rates (better for us than "then-current rates"), and expressly including knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, and continued service at existing scope and service levels.
- **11.2** — return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and no withholding for fee disputes.
- **11.3** — deletion only *after* we confirm successful return, with written certification by an authorized officer and continued protection of any copy retained under Applicable Law.

Cross-checks: Section 9 contains no carve-out disapplying transition assistance (including on termination for Customer breach); Section 10 preserves our rights in Customer Data and Deliverables; Section 15 imposes no conflicting deletion or use rights. Section 11 is triggered by its own terms "upon expiry or termination," so the absence of a general survival clause does not undermine it.
